description.value: A 34-site BC Parks campground on the shores of Conkle Lake in the Okanagan-Similkameen, with potable water and washrooms available during the operating season; the gate stays open year-round (weather permitting) so shoulder-season stops are possible, though services and fees only apply in season.

address.value: BC-3, Kootenay Boundary, BC V0H 1Y0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Conkle Lake Campground is an active, publicly bookable campground within Conkle Lake Park in the Okanagan Highland. The website's prominent 'Book camping' button and mention of reservation policies for frontcountry and group camping confirm reservations are accepted. The fetched content does not describe specific amenity details (toilets, water, showers, etc.), so those fields remain null; OSM confirms no internet access and a fee is charged.
concerns: OSM name is 'Conkle Lake Campground' while the BC Parks website titles the page 'Conkle Lake Park'; the campground is a facility within the park, so the OSM name is acceptable but slightly narrower.
Phone number (+1-250-584-9025) from OSM was not corroborated in the fetched website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational BC Parks campground with active online booking; clearly publicly accessible with 34 sites.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM capacity tag indicates 34 sites. Operator listed in OSM as Quality Recreation Ltd. Access roads explicitly described as unsuitable for motorhomes, trailers, and low-clearance vehicles — noteworthy context for cyclists approaching by loaded touring bike.
